slices.focus: Fall holds arrive and Colleen builds a second package, now running a two-part school program with measurable pipeline categories.
slices.summary: Colleen gets real fall holds from schools, not just vague interest. She builds a second package for lower grades (neighborhood fire safety, object handling). Her spreadsheet now separates museum visits, in-school outreach, and probable repeats into distinct categories. Mood shifts from discouraged to cautiously encouraged because the pipeline has shape. She prepares a one-page internal summary and plans a soft release of the new package.
